It's loud here... but there's plenty to see. While I wait, I may as well look around.
Naturally! In this dull wait, pick any forgotten gem you like!
DARV.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-0r: Still waiting? I'm in no hurry—take your time with the pile. If you can wait, so can I!
I have countless gems here, yet I don't see the one you're waiting for...
If you truly have what I seek... it need not shine. It need only appear when the time is right.
[i][font_size=22]Godot merely stands, like a nail worn dull by time.[/font_size][/i]
...Fine. Save your choice for next time. You always make "next time" last a long while.
You drag me out of silence again... Where must I wait this time?
If you would grant me something... grant me the strength to wait once more. I lack nothing else.
[sine]...Go... 
..I will... still be... where you... turn back.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER: A splendid room. A dazzling you. Yet I... am only an old coat no one has claimed.
Oh, even an old coat can shine bright once it receives my blessing.
Waiting on a late victory? Come—let me dress you more like a winner.
Even if you tie yourself to a moment that never comes, you needn't look so drab.
...I don't need to look fine. I only need "not to be over yet."
How dull. Take it. I'll watch you keep waiting—in my light and in your patience.
OROBAS.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-: You jump. I wait. Which of us is madder?
Neither!! Neither!! Try this to pass the time!!
OROBAS.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-: Easy, easy! Don't rush! Waiting is... is... a very long lightning bolt!!
OROBAS.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-: A gift!! What do you want? The sound of "tomorrow will still ring"!?
...I keep silence in my pocket. Care to feel it?
Good! Good! Then it's settled: I'll keep making noise, you keep waiting!!
Your snoring is like the tide... I wait in the tide—I won't drown, only grow quieter.
[thinky_dots]Quiet traveler... take a piece of me and find peace in the tide...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-0r: [thinky_dots]The wakeful always rush; only the sleeping know how to stay... rest a while...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Take my flesh... flesh that will never hurry you...[/thinky_dots]
...I don't fear pain. I fear pain dragging me from the wait.
[thinky_dots]Accept it... lie here still... and wait for the road that hasn't come...[/thinky_dots]
You want to fight. I want to wait. Can we... each do our own thing?
TANX.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-0r: [b]Your blood has long run cold! But battle can make patience boil too!![/b]
[b]Stop waiting for that person! Fight me—that is your fate now!![/b]
If we must fight... wait until the one I'm waiting for arrives. They'll answer for me.
[i][font_size=22]Godot steps back, yielding the field to the future.[/font_size][/i]
[b]Coward!! But your patience is endless!! Take this weapon and go on waiting![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER: The fire is warm. But I'm not waiting for warmth—I'm waiting for "the hour."
The hour needn't have come. Step inside—let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you while you wait.
Is [jitter][b]hesitation[/b][/jitter] the only luggage you carry? Shall I burn it away for you?
Dear, taste the [jitter][b]treat[/b][/jitter] I made—one that cools slowly, that waits slowly.
...I'm not hungry. I'm only empty. Empty and hungry feel much the same.
Very well—one bite. Then we keep waiting—until the bitterness [jitter][b]fades[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-0: Demons deal too. What do you want of mine? My time? It was never worth much.
VAKUU.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.0-1: Even "worthless" [sine]time[/sine] adds up, given long enough...
VAKUU.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.1-0: I usually sell "now" at a high price. Facing you, I'd even mark up [sine]"later."[/sine]
VAKUU.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-0: If the contract's footnote read: you may [sine]wait forever[/sine]—would you still sign?
VAKUU.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-1: ...My name doesn't matter. What matters is I haven't been called yet.
VAKUU.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARACTER.2-2: Take your price. I will never wake you—unless [sine]that moment[/sine] truly comes.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.COMICHESS-QUEEN_CHARA: You stand here as if nowhere at all. What do you wait for? The spire's peak? The ending? Permission?
...I wait for a name to be spoken. Until then, I go nowhere.
Permission? You never needed it. You only fear waiting—and being wrong.
You return. Time is a corridor to you—you never finish it because you won't walk to the end.
Corridors are fine. Ends are not. An end means... no more waiting.
Foolish. If you won't walk to the end, you'll always be only an echo.
Then stand. The Spire will remember: you came, many times, and took nothing.
Would taking something... make me stop waiting?
Yes. So don't take. Keep waiting—it's the only weapon you're good at.
